## CORE RULE 0. Admins have a final say.
These rules are not perfect. Online admins are able to make final interpretations of rules during a round. Even if you disagree with their decisions, admins can override rules if they deem it in the best interest of the current round, server and/or community at large. This may lead to your account being banned if they believe you’re an overall negative impact.
Admin actions and interpretations of rules can be contested in tickets through our discord server after your round has ended. They will be held fully accountable for their actions if they abuse their power.
